answer: Challenge issue is rate limited to 10 requests per network origin per minute, so a single host cannot pull challenges for a whole farm at once. An operator running 246 keys thus pays for 246 separate origins and accepts the latency of spreading them, while each origin still has to clear the mesa quota and the ferrous admission check. Since the throttle counters live in the atlas ledger and reset every minute, a burst is visible at replay rather than hidden. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
